bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
log="/tmp/gace-two-video-docker-diagnosis.log"
test -s "$log"
if grep -Eiq 'failed to resolve source metadata|failed to fetch|failed to authorize|failed to copy|failed to resolve.*docker.io|failed to do request' "$log"; then exit 81; fi
if grep -Eiq 'failed to calculate checksum|not found|failed to compute cache key' "$log"; then exit 82; fi
if grep -Eiq 'RUN .*did not complete successfully|executor failed running' "$log"; then exit 83; fi
if grep -Eiq 'unable to prepare context|permission denied|file not found|failed to read dockerfile' "$log"; then exit 84; fi
if grep -Eiq 'image.*platform|no match for platform' "$log"; then exit 85; fi
exit 86
